note: Starter vocabulary. Which wheels are driven. AWD and 4WD are kept distinct because they behave differently in the traction model: a part-time 4WD system with a locked transfer case is not the same launch case as an on-demand AWD system.

terms.label: Front-wheel drive
terms.description: Drive to the front axle only.

terms.label: Rear-wheel drive
terms.description: Drive to the rear axle only.

terms.label: All-wheel drive
terms.description: Permanent or on-demand drive to both axles via a centre differential or clutch pack.

terms.label: Four-wheel drive
terms.description: Selectable or part-time four-wheel drive, typically with a transfer case and low range.
